next.reason: 1985: 'The key word FILLER may be used to name a data item. Under no circumstances can a FILLER item be referred to explicitly'; FILLER may name a conditional variable. §2023:13.18.20.4 GR1: 'The word FILLER may be used to name a data, report, or screen item. Under no circumstances shall a FILLER item be referred to explicitly'; §2023:13.18.20.3 SR3 admits FILLER in a report group description entry, which the 1985 format '01 [data-name-1]' refuses; §2023:13.16.3 SR24 keeps the conditional-variable allowance. FILLER-named report/screen items are accepted: range widened.
